decision.reason: [ev-73055e956e96] says only that the Helm chart's write pods now use `/ingester/shutdown` in their preStop hook. It does not say which workload kind the write pods are or which values cause them to render, so nothing supports the proposed "Deployment in use AND values key `write` set" condition. The values validator found no key `write.lifecycle.preStop.exec.command` in the values of either release ([ev-6b828f5bc194], [ev-72c19aa86056]), which undercuts P1's reading of the subject. To decide exposure, we need the chart's write-pod templates or a rendered diff that shows which object kind carries the preStop hook and which deployment-mode or values settings render it.
